title: The invoice created email goes only to the payer's portal contacts
custom_preconds:
BLOCKED ON RELEASE: this test checks a customer portal change that ships in the customer portal app's own release (the Bill To PRD's release dependency for the customer portal story). Do not run it now. It can be tested once that portal release is out.

Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a shop that uses the customer portal.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, with contact A1, who can sign in to the customer portal.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with contact B1, who can sign in to the customer portal.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Create Invoice.
  4. Check contact B1's mailbox.
  5. Check contact A1's mailbox.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab shows Create Invoice.

Step 3:

  • The invoice is created.

Step 4:

  • Contact B1, customer B's portal contact, has the "invoice created" email for work order 1.

Step 5:

  • Contact A1 has no "invoice created" email for work order 1.
